info.title: ApiToolKit - Firebase Admin APIs (FCM, Auth, Remote Config, App Check)
info.description: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture integration for Firebase Admin APIs. Covers Firebase Cloud Messaging v1, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Remote Config, and Firebase App Check.

post.summary: Verify a Firebase App Check token.

get.summary: Batch get App Check enforcement configurations for multiple apps.

patch.summary: Batch update App Check enforcement configurations for multiple apps.

post.summary: Send a push notification to a specific device token using FCM v1.
Send a push notification to a topic using FCM v1.
Send a push notification based on a topic condition using FCM v1.
Send push notifications to multiple device tokens (up to 500) using FCM v1.
Subscribe device tokens to a FCM topic.
Unsubscribe device tokens from a FCM topic.

get.summary: Get the Google OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for Firebase scopes.
Handle the OAuth 2.0 callback and exchange the authorization code for Firebase tokens.

post.summary: Refresh a Firebase OAuth access token using a refresh token.
Sign up a new Firebase user with email and password.
Sign in an existing Firebase user with email and password.

get.summary: Get Firebase user account info using an ID token, localId, or email.

put.summary: Update the Firebase user's display name or photo URL.

get.summary: List all users in a Firebase project (Admin).

delete.summary: Delete a Firebase user by localId (Admin).

post.summary: Create a Firebase custom token for a user.

get.summary: Get the current Firebase Remote Config template for a project.

put.summary: Update the Firebase Remote Config template for a project.
